items.experiment: Wrong-rate ratio of early-marker to late-marker finished answers of the cued base at T 1.0 (MATH-500, T1).

Cause share: of the cued base's quick finished-wrong T1 answers (at most 2,000 generated tokens), the fraction that are early-marker answers. The rival (slow-reasoning slips stated at the end) puts few of them in the early group.
